unit: family × verdict state (one decision cell per family's strength/weakness half)

definition.confirmed: Unchanged frozen conjunction: meanNetR > +0.10R AND day-clustered tNet > 2 AND excessVsRandomR > 0 AND day-clustered t > 2 AND n >= 100 AND concentration <= 0.50 AND LOYO >= 0.75 AND NO_BASELINE clear.
definition.eligibleSameBarCandidates: 74,886 means eligible EFFICIENT/CHOPPY signal instances across the 24-card pre-deletion A5 library, reduced to unique bar indices after lowest-priority same-bar resolution, before the one-slot book dropped occupied-period candidates. This historical denominator is not recomputed as if the deleted cards had never existed.
definition.thinPower: THIN-POWER is a diagnostic label only: family × verdict power at true net +0.20R below 0.50. It does not change any criterion or threshold.

method.counts: A6 per-family × verdict n is the sum of surviving card-specific one-slot records. Kish nEffective is recomputed over duplicate kept entry bars within each family/state; same-bar duplicates are not falsely counted as independent information.
method.dayClustering: Use measured random-entry-baseline CR1/plain-SE inflation per verdict state, clustered by canonical EAT calendar date: 1.3222 EFFICIENT and 1.1202 CHOPPY. Family-cell SE = matching-session-weighted random-baseline SD × measured verdict-state CR1 inflation / sqrt(Kish nEffective). Actual family cell date/year counts are preserved in slot-model.json.
method.baselines: Random-baseline means/SDs are weighted by that family/state's measured session mix using existing state × session matched-control fine cells.
method.simulation: 10,000 parametric runs per family × verdict × edge, common net/excess noise, and measured per-year survivor counts for concentration/LOYO simulations; NO strategy returns, exits or claim results are used.
method.analyticCrossCheck: Net-gate P(meanNet > .10 AND tNet > 2) = Phi((edge - max(.10, 2*SE))/SE). Monte Carlo estimates of the same net gate are recorded alongside the analytic value.

dependence.unitSpecificKish: familyPowerStructure contains n, nEffective, design effect, per-day counts, per-year counts, and session composition for every family × verdict state.

requestedPooledConstraintCorrection: Pooled power below a component cell's power is expected at true edges below +0.10R due to the frozen absolute-mean floor. The 'never below' relation applies only at edges at or above +0.10R; no rule or threshold was changed.
note: Report-only capacity/power model; not strategy verification. Cards remain DRAFT. No Map, state, parameter, priority, cost, exit or CONFIRMED criterion changed.
